items.description: 56 × 28 × 3.8 mm overall; 50 × 28 × 3 mm plate; left-edge lug center (-27,0), outer diameter 8 mm and through-hole diameter 4 mm, axis Z; 0.4/0.8 mm relief on other artwork. Central 43 × 4 mm capsule recessed 0.4 mm with 2.6 mm floor. Knob center (18,-1), diameter 4 mm, top Z=3.8 mm preserved. Lug-to-plate shoulders use two tangent R2 mm concave outline fillets per user markup.
items.selection_reason: Custom single solid with a left-edge keyring hole and smoothly rounded lug roots as requested; default R2 mm shoulder transitions retain the hole, body and artwork dimensions.

supply_risks.description: Small lettering and icon strokes are visual-model features; fabrication fidelity requires a process-specific check before printing or casting.
